entries.title: Psalms 94:1
segments: ¶O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongs-O God, to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth!

entries.title: Psalms 94:2
segments: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; Render punishment to the proud.

entries.title: Psalms 94:3
segments: LORD, how long will the wicked, How long will the wicked triumph?

entries.title: Psalms 94:4
segments: They utter speech, [and] speak insolent things; All the workers of iniquity boast in themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 94:5
segments: They break in pieces Your people, O LORD, And afflict Your heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 94:6
segments: They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 94:7
segments: Yet they say, "The LORD does not see, Nor does the God of Jacob understand."

entries.title: Psalms 94:8
segments: Understand, you senseless among the people; And [you] fools, when will you be wise?

entries.title: Psalms 94:9
segments: He who planted the ear, shall He not hear? He who formed the eye, shall He not see?

entries.title: Psalms 94:10
segments: He who instructs the nations, shall He not correct, He who teaches man knowledge?

entries.title: Psalms 94:11
segments: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, That they [are] futile.

entries.title: Psalms 94:12
segments: ¶Blessed [is] the man whom You instruct, O LORD, And teach out of Your law,

entries.title: Psalms 94:13
segments: That You may give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit is dug for the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 94:14
segments: For the LORD will not cast off His people, Nor will He forsake His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 94:15
segments: But judgment will return to righteousness, And all the upright in heart will follow it.

entries.title: Psalms 94:16
segments: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Psalms 94:17
segments: Unless the LORD [had been] my help, My soul would soon have settled in silence.

entries.title: Psalms 94:18
segments: If I say, "My foot slips," Your mercy, O LORD, will hold me up.

entries.title: Psalms 94:19
segments: In the multitude of my anxieties within me, Your comforts delight my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 94:20
segments: Shall the throne of iniquity, which devises evil by law, Have fellowship with You?

entries.title: Psalms 94:21
segments: They gather together against the life of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.

entries.title: Psalms 94:22
segments: But the LORD has been my defense, And my God the rock of my refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 94:23
segments: He has brought on them their own iniquity, And shall cut them off in their own wickedness; The LORD our God shall cut them off.
